A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as a '''shuttle operator''' for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While a travel advisory was in effect for the [[Old Galactic Market]], he dealt with a [[Unidentified Twi'lek businessman|businessman]] who wished to travel there.

==Biography==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} The three aforementioned classes all visit [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during their respective Prologues. As this is the first time they can witness the conversation between the [[Unidentified Twi'lek businessman|businessman]] and the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] operator, it can be inferred the conversation takes place during their Prologues and therefore in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] operator worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a member of its [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|security force]] while a travel advisory was in place for the [[Old Galactic Market]] region,<ref name="TOR" /> which was then the location of an [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|uprising]] by the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]].<ref name="SWTORCiGC">{{TORcite|type=general|Crisis in Galactic City|Coruscant}}</ref> Stationed at the [[Air taxi/Legends|taxi]] pad outside the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], he dealt with a [[Unidentified Twi'lek businessman|businessman]] who claimed a need to travel to the Old Galactic Market. The operator replied that he was not the one who made the rules and would have to obey the advisory, but the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] businessman informed the shuttle operator that he carried a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. The businessman then asked if they could leave. The shuttle operator replied that he would need to sign a waiver first.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
The shuttle operator had [[Color/Legends|dark]] skin and [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
The operator wore a white and dark-grey [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], as well as brown pockets. The uniform featured a white version<ref name="TOR" /> of the insignia on the uniforms of many Coruscant Security Force personnel at that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Coruscant">{{TORcite|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle operator first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] by [[BioWare]], identified by his NPC nameplate as "Shuttle Operator."<ref name="TOR" />
